clips.title: The story
paras: In Hillsbrad Fields, a crate of raw iron waits at the human smithy. The metal feeds local arms production, making the shipment a target for Forsaken forces seeking to cut the supply lines that arm the townsfolk.

Across the Hillsbrad Foothills, human peasants have mounted stiff resistance against Tarren Mill. Much of their strength comes from the smithy at the southwestern edge of Hillsbrad Fields, where Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices work round the clock, making weapons and armor from heavy shipments of iron. Forsaken commanders ordered the forge put out, its smiths killed, and its stored metal seized for the Horde war effort, hoping to break the farmers’ resolve.
